name: hashicorp-deck
description: HashiCorp-branded presentation skills. `hashicorp-deck-html` emits a self-contained .html scroll deck: monochrome foundation with sparing product-gradient accents, mono structural labels, scroll-reveal animation, side nav dots, keyboard paging and Flight-icon feature cards. `hashicorp-deck-htmltopptx` converts an HTML deck into an editable .pptx re-typeset on the official HashiCorp CY26 presentation kit, light or dark, with the two sharing one layout grammar so a deck can be rebuilt in either, and fills the kit's icon squares with the same Flight icons. Both carry their design system as authoritative tokens so decks built in different repos stay consistent.
